summary: AGENTS.md: promote the grouped-member lifecycle corollary to the row-lock rule
description:
**Promote a proven learning (from TKT-53) into AGENTS.md.**

The repo already documents the state-deriving-catalog-slot-transition row-lock rule. TKT-53 added a corollary worth making a standard: when a slot belongs to a grouping (festival, and by extension future passes/lodging), its per-member lifecycle endpoints (`PublishPerformance`/`ArchivePerformance`) must **reject** a grouped member (`ErrGroupedSlotLifecycle`) so the group aggregate cannot be desynced out-of-band. This is now proven across performance/series/festival and was a REQUEST-CHANGES finding on TKT-53.

**Scope:** one paragraph added to the existing row-lock bullet in AGENTS.md, citing `ErrGroupedSlotLifecycle` + the guarded `PublishPerformance`/`ArchivePerformance` in `services/catalog/internal/store/postgres.go` as the reference impl. Docs-only.

**COS:** AGENTS.md states the corollary; no code change. risk:low (documentation, isolated).

comments.body:
<!-- sdlc:stage=ready kind=blocker -->
**Blocked on TKT-53 — the learning this ticket promotes has not landed on `main`.**

Verified against `origin/main` (not the ticket text) before claiming:

- `ErrGroupedSlotLifecycle` does not exist anywhere in the repo — no match in any Go file.
- `PublishPerformance` (`services/catalog/internal/store/postgres.go:428`) and
  `ArchivePerformance` (`:547`) exist but carry **no grouped-member guard**. There is no
  festival concept in the catalog store beyond an incidental comment at `:810`.
- TKT-53 is still in **Building** with `needs:human`; its PR (#37) is **open, not merged**.

So the corollary is real but lives only in an unmerged PR. AGENTS.md is repo-local gospel for
every future agent: documenting a symbol and a "reference impl" that are absent from `main`
would be worse than no entry at all. Promotion is also a **Done** step per the skill — TKT-53
has not cleared Gate 3, let alone Gate 4. This ticket was queued to `Ready` ahead of the work
it promotes.

**Unblock condition:** PR #37 merges, and `ErrGroupedSlotLifecycle` + the guarded
`PublishPerformance`/`ArchivePerformance` are confirmed present on `origin/main`. The final
wording must cite the merged code — if review renames the error or moves the guard, the
paragraph follows the code, not this description.

Left in `Ready` (not dragged to `BLOCKED`): status moves are the human's call.
